Notes
*1 S3 access points require ONTAP 9.17.1 or later
Same Region, same account, and a mounted volume
*2 Authorization is evaluated in two layers
A request has to pass both IAM and file system permissions
*4 Hardware testing incomplete
The edge side and ONTAP integration are unverified
